title: Full-page photo of an Assyrian winged lamassu relief
summary: A full-page magenta-tinted photograph of an Assyrian lamassu relief: a winged bull with a human head in profile, a tall patterned tiara, a long curled beard and rows of carved feathers on stone. White margins frame it and it has no text.
educationalPurpose: Image-only source page: students identify the lamassu as a palace guardian and link Assyrian art, religion and royal power in ancient Mesopotamia.

title: Full-page photo of an Assyrian lamassu relief in orange tones
summary: A full-page orange-tinted photograph of an Assyrian lamassu relief in profile: a bearded human head under a decorated cap, huge feathered wings and a bull's forequarters carved on stone. White margins frame it and no text appears.
educationalPurpose: Observation page for visual analysis: learners describe carving detail, wings and protective symbolism of Assyrian monumental art.

title: Full-page purple-toned photo of an Assyrian lamassu
summary: A full-page violet-tinted photograph of an Assyrian lamassu relief: a winged bull with a human head, curled beard, crested tiara and rows of carved feathers against a plain stone wall. White margins frame it and no text appears.
educationalPurpose: Supports study of Mesopotamian sculpture: students describe materials, meaning and function of guardian figures at Assyrian palace entrances.
